hypothesis.implication: Structural anchor retrieval ranks the preregistered cross-domain matches above TF-IDF semantic, keyword, recency and random retrieval on this corpus.

experiment_state.summary: MRR — structural 0.511, sequence 0.426, semantic 0.257, keyword 0.228, recency 0.244, random 0.25. Structural ranks (per probe): 3, 1, 5. Beats 4/4 baselines; hits@1=1.

promotion_state.note: Independent (non-builder) review required before any promotion; autonomy in calibration.

lesson.statement: Structural anchor retrieval outranked most baselines at locating preregistered cross-domain matches on a 15-trajectory corpus (claim ceiling: provisional / domain_specific at n=14 curated trajectories; transferable requires live-capture replication in a later epoch).

routine_summary: Structural echo evaluation classified provisional. No intervention required.
